title: Supply Planning Manager
teaser: Join us as a Supply Planning Manager to lead end-to-end component supply planning, ensuring Cisco meets global revenue targets. Drive supply continuity and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Ideal for experienced professionals in materials management and supply planning.
description:
Meet the Team: 

As a Global Component Planner, you will be responsible for end-to-end component supply planning for specific commodity to ensure Cisco meets its global revenue targets. You will work cross-functionally with Supply Chain Operation teams to drive supply continuity, collaborative planning, and navigate complex technology lifecycles.

Your Impact: 

Strategic Supply Planning: Design and execute end-to-end global supply plans for related commodities, including integrated co-planning initiatives with key suppliers. 

Inventory & Fulfillment Excellence: Partner with global hub operations to optimize inbound fulfillment modes. Own the inventory decision-making process, ensuring all actions align with Cisco’s "Weeks of Supply" (WOS) strategy and financial goals. 

Shortage Mitigation & Agility: Proactively identify and resolve component shortages through agile communication and rapid problem-solving with regional partners and global suppliers. 

E&O Management: Utilize advanced analytical and collaborative techniques to manage and mitigate Excess & Obsolescence (E&O) risks while maximizing total revenue potential. 

Supplier & Commodity Strategy: Cultivate strong partnerships with Global Supplier Management (SuCM) and external vendors to ensure commodity-specific strategies are aligned with Cisco’s business requirements. 

NPI & Technology Transitions: Lead the commodity supply response to volatile industry transitions. Coordinate closely with Engineering, Hubs, and Suppliers to manage qualifications and ensure successful New Product Introduction (NPI) ramp-ups. 

Cross-Functional Leadership: Drive alignment across extended partner teams—including Finance and Business Units—to ensure a synchronized approach to component planning and supply chain resilience. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

8+ years’ experience with Materials Management, Supplier Relationship Management and/or Supply/Demand Planning 

Experience and knowledge of manufacturing processes and procedures 

Experience with data analysis, data analytics and data modeling 

Preferred Qualifications: 

Experience with inventory management
